description: Append ONE rule to the tenant rule book, which every agent reads at start. Use it when a human says a rule applies to all bots ("jeder Bot soll …", "Polizei: ab jetzt immer …") — instead of copying it into each agent's memory. Required: rule (one sentence or short paragraph), requested_by (who asked, e.g. "Max Mustermann"). The line is dated and attributed; an identical rule is not added twice. Changing or deleting existing rules is done by an admin in the app (see get_tenant_rules link).

requested_by.description: Name of the person who asked for the rule

rule.description: The rule text, one sentence or short paragraph, read by every agent

name: add_tenant_rule
